query_analysis.original_query: We are looking to develop a more energy-efficient approach to extract ethanol from a 95% azeotropic mixture. Any suggestions on alternative distillation or hybrid methods?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Design an energy-efficient method to separate ethanol from its 95% ethanol-water azeotrope mixture, considering alternative distillation techniques or hybrid separation methods that can overcome azeotropic limitations.

selected_agents.role: Design alternative separation methods to overcome azeotrope limitations
Analyze phase equilibria and thermodynamic properties of the ethanol-water system
Perform process modeling and energy optimization calculations
Integrate separation methods into overall process design considering economic feasibility

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative design and optimization incorporating thermodynamic analysis and energy modeling
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Collaborative development with continuous feedback among agents

clarification_questions: What is the scale of your operation and desired ethanol purity?
Do you have any constraints on equipment, capital investment, or energy consumption?
Have you previously tried any alternative separation methods?
